title: Departure from Warsaw toward the Soviet Union
summary: The narrator left Warsaw with Lukow acquaintances toward the east and the Soviet Union after the invasion and bombardments; no numeric year is stated.
uncertaintyNote: The year is inferred from the historical reference to the invasion, while the text itself gives no numeric date.
